dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, this wedding is beautiful! Who's the man next to the bride's mother?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈðɪs ˈwɛdɪŋ ɪz ˈbjuːtəfəl! ˈhuːz ðə ˈmæn ˈnɛkst tə ðə ˈbraɪdz ˈmʌðər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's my uncle. He's married to my mom's sister.
dialogue.reading: ðæts maɪ ˈʌŋkəl. hiːz ˈmærid tə maɪ ˈmɑːmz ˈsɪstər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And the young woman in the pink dress? Is she related to you, too?
dialogue.reading: ənd ðə ˈjʌŋ ˈwʊmən ɪn ðə ˈpɪŋk ˈdrɛs? ɪz ʃiː rɪˈleɪtɪd tə juː, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, she's Kwan's younger sister. She's engaged to a doctor.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ʃiːz ˈkwɑːnz ˈjʌŋɡər ˈsɪstər. ʃiːz ɪnˈɡeɪdʒd tə ə ˈdɑːktər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Everyone in your family is getting married!
dialogue.reading: ˈɛvriwʌn ɪn jʊr ˈfæməli ɪz ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈmærid!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not me! Look, there's my grandmother. I'm very fond of her.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt miː! ˈlʊk, ðɛrz maɪ ˈɡrænmʌðər. aɪm ˈvɛri ˈfɑːnd əv hɜːr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: She's sweet. And who's the boy next to Fah?
dialogue.reading: ʃiːz ˈswiːt. ənd ˈhuːz ðə ˈbɔɪ ˈnɛkst tə ˈfɑː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's a friend of Kwan's from Chiang Mai. I think Fah is crazy about him!
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈfrɛnd əv ˈkwɑːnz frəm ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ. aɪ ˈθɪŋk ˈfɑː ɪz ˈkreɪzi əˌbaʊt hɪm!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Ha! And that man by the door keeps looking at me.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ənd ðæt ˈmæn baɪ ðə ˈdɔːr ˈkiːps ˈlʊkɪŋ ət miː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I think he's attracted to you!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk hiːz əˈtræktɪd tə juː!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Too bad for him! I'm crazy about Ryan!
dialogue.reading: ˈtuː ˈbæd fər hɪm! aɪm ˈkreɪzi əˌbaʊt ˈraɪən!
